description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.
 
 Clearance Required: TS/SCI with CI Polygraph
 Location: National Capital Region (NCR) or San Antonio, TX
 
 Nightwing is seeking an Expert Software Engineer that provides technical leadership and advanced engineering expertise for the most complex and critical aspects of the unified AMS/FIPE solution. This position works on high-visibility mission-critical components, establishes engineering standards, and oversees technical efforts of development teams. With deep expertise in offensive cyber operations and enterprise software development, the Expert Engineer ensures the delivery of robust, scalable solutions that meet stringent security and performance requirements.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead architecture and design of critical system components
 Provide technical leadership for complex engineering challenges
 Establish coding standards and engineering best practices
 Conduct advanced troubleshooting and performance optimization
 Lead integration efforts with external systems and platforms
 Mentor and oversee work of less senior engineers
 Participate in technical planning and roadmap development
 Lead security architecture implementation
 Support critical production issues requiring deep technical expertise
 Represent team in technical exchange meetings with stakeholders
 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Minimum 14 years of software engineering experience with 5+ years in cyber operations
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent substitution)
 Expert-level knowledge of distributed systems architecture
 Deep expertise in multiple technology stacks and programming paradigms
 Extensive experience with cloud-native development and multi-cloud architectures
 Advanced understanding of security principles and secure coding practices
 Proven track record leading complex technical implementations
 Strong knowledge of offensive cyber operations mission requirements
 Experience with workflow orchestration and automation platforms
 Active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph
 Must be U.S. citizen
 Salary & Benefits
The salary associated with this position ($122,000-$253,000) is commensurate with the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, and demonstrated level of expertise. Compensation will be determined based on these factors to ensure alignment with skills, responsibilities, and market standards. Nightwing offers medical, vision and dental insurance coverage in addition to a 401k plan, PTO, Holidays, and additional insurances. 
 Nightwing is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.
